tagline: I build and automate reliable Linux infrastructure, increasingly with AI agents in the loop. This page runs on it.
about_p1: I'm based in Dortmund and have learned Linux and DevOps through self-study. After a long career in logistics, I'm deliberately returning to IT. I first gained hands-on experience at school by administering Linux game servers over SSH/FTP, maintaining PHP forums and building HTML websites.
about_p2: Today I design, automate and operate a self-hosted Raspberry Pi 5 environment running 24/7 with Docker, monitoring, DNS and AI services. I am looking for a Junior DevOps or Linux Systems Administrator role and am available from January 2027.
